name: Mr. Whiteman's house and Franciscan Fort, Macao
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of 'the forty pillared house', also known as the house of John Clarmont Whiteman (founder of Whiteman & Co.), at the end of the Praya Grande overlooking the Franciscan Green, Macau; beyond are the steps and fort of S. Francisco.
